tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (blue family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.
